text:
maya: Quick sync — draft PRD for 'API feature buckets' is up: https://rwd/PRD-1965. Looking for scope decisions for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank. TL;DR: propose 3 buckets -> low-latency chat, bulk embeddings, high-precision rerank. Can we align launch gates?
ton y: reading. quick Q: does 'low-latency chat' require streaming + function calls at GA?
maya: yes streaming GA, function-calls v1 optional. Acceptance criteria suggestion: avg p95 latency <= 200ms for 8k context under dedicated 1k qps test harness and streaming supports partial tokens + eos handling. I'll add to PRD.
samir: for embeddings bucket — do we need batching/autocache? several customers asked for bulk upsert + low-cost retrieval pattern.
eva: embeddings GA: batch endpoint with multipart upload + backpressure. Acceptance: bulk-export <= 50k vectors/min on dedicated pools and embedding dimensionality documented + stable model pin. Also list failure modes: partial writes, duplicate ids, retry semantics.
maya: good. For rerank: tradeoff between server-side scoring vs client side. Proposal: rerank as a separate endpoint that accepts up to 50 candidates + context + returns score list sorted. Acceptance criteria: deterministic ordering, ties stable, score calibration doc, and side-channel metadata for model variant.
rika (eng-ml): edge cases for rerank: empty candidate list, identical candidates, very long candidate text (>8k). We should define truncation policy: prefer 400 with clear error vs silent truncation.
ton y: prefer 400 + clear error code. Also add backward compatibility header: `X-Rerank-Variant: stable-v1`.
deploy-bot: load test scheduled: job/1965-api-buckets-load runs tonight 23:00 UTC.
maya: infra gating: need quantized model variant for rerank to meet latency SLOs. Eng-runtime to confirm kernel availability and fallback plan.
samir: devex ask: add quickstart snippet in README showing multi-call pattern for embeddings bulk + retry guidance. Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk \\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n -F "file=@vectors.ndjson"
```
maya: good, add to PRD.
eva: legal note: data retention for embeddings bulk must be opt-in; default no retention. @legal-bot please confirm.
legal-bot: flagged — need consent checkbox + KMS logging. I'll DM product checklist.
maya: last ask: decide canary policy. Proposal: canary 10% traffic for 48h, rollback on quality regression >2% and latency breach p95>250ms. Thoughts?
ton y: +1. also add automatic fallback to hosted smaller model if rerank variant overloaded.
rika: I'll add explicit regression eval set and alert hooks in console. Need owner for eval -> assign to Rika.
maya: assigning: Rika (eng-ml) owner for eval set, Tony owner for runtime tuning, Samir owner for devex docs.
samir: noted.
eva: ok from product side, I'll update PRD with these acceptance criteria and edge cases.
maya: thanks all. I'll push PRD update and ping again after load test. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: job/1965-api-buckets-load completed: 95th p95=220ms embeddings bulk throughput 48k/min. Pass for now.
ton y: nice — still need rerank quantization check.

(threads end)
